Proud to take the stage at @websummit Rio 2026 as a speaker in the Breakout Startups Showcase. 🚀

From the mic checks and final run-throughs backstage to sharing Dealism’s vision in front of a global audience, every moment reminded me that great products are never built alone. 

A huge thank you to the Web Summit team, the production crew, our partners, customers, and everyone working behind the scenes to make this experience possible.

This is just the beginning! 🇧🇷✨

#WebSummitRio #BreakoutStartups #dealism
